data.name: Submission Saga: The Jiu Jitsu RPG
data.detailed_description:
You start as a white belt nobody. By the end you can be a world championship black belt.

Submission Saga is a top-down pixel-art RPG that mixes Pokémon-style exploration with turn-based Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. Train at the gym. Level up eight BJJ stats. Unlock new techniques as you climb the belts. Time the submission gauge to get a perfect lock-in and outthink six jiu jitsu archetypes. Every fight is simultaneous-resolution scored by real BJJ points.

Outside the gym there's a whole world to explore. Enter tournaments, defeat gym leaders, and fight at the World Championship arena. Forage mushrooms in the forest, fish quiet ponds, and brawl street thugs. Build your own signature submissions with the Custom Move Creator.

The supplement shelf is fully stocked. Creatine, pre-workout, and a few bottles with the labels scratched off.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Climb the Belt Ladder: White, blue, purple, brown, black. Each promotion unlocks new positions, harder opponents, and bigger paydays.

  • 8 Real BJJ Stats: Guard, Passing, Submissions, Escapes, Wrestling, Cardio, Strength, and Leg Entanglements.

  • 90+ Moves, 19 Positions: Open guard sweeps, flying triangles, inside heel hooks. Unlock them by training, completing quests, or winning competitions to level up.

  • Submission Timing Gauge: A precision timing test during combat. Perfect timing gives an increased finish chance.

  • 6 Fighting Archetypes: Wrestler, Guard Player, Pressure Passer, Defensive Specialist, Submission Specialist, All-Rounder. Design your own grappling style.

  • Tournaments and World Championship: Single-elimination brackets and an arena climb for the world title.

  • Business Empire: Açai Stand, Laundromat, your own Training Gym, and more. Three upgrade tiers each. Passive income accrues while you play. 

  • Lift and do Cardio for Real Gains: Hit the weight room to push your strength and to build your cardio.

  • Open World Exploration: Explore cities, new gyms, forests, and hidden areas.

  • Rivals, Training Partners, and Pets: A multi-stage rival arc from white belt to black. A purple-belt training buddy at your home gym. Adoptable dog and pets that hang behind you everywhere by.

  • 23 Quests, 50 Achievements, Daily Challenges: Three randomized objectives every day on top of the storyline.

  • The Supplement Shelf: Creatine, pre-workout, açaí bowls. Plus a few suspiciously dosed items.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with Vulkan 1.0 or OpenGL ES 3.0 support (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent, 2012+)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Online PvP and leaderboards require an internet connection. Offline play is fully supported for the single-player campaign.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (universal binary)
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (any Mac from 2012 or later)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Universal binary supports both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs natively. Online PvP and leaderboards require an internet connection.
